parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe, typically made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface with maps printed on it.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface for geographical information and can rotate around its axis for viewing different regions.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the supporting structure of the globe, usually made of metal, consisting of the stand and the axis frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the rotating sphere, maintaining the globe’s orientation and balance.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing the sphere to rotate smoothly around its axis.
